faqs.q: What is a 1-1/2 inch (DN40) industrial ball valve used for?
faqs.a: A 1-1/2 inch (DN40) industrial ball valve isolates process, utility and plant lines in stainless, carbon steel and brass bodies. Indus lists eight makes in this size, rated up to 4,000 psi, on the [industrial ball valves shelf](/c/industrial-ball-valves).

faqs.q: Which makes of 1-1/2 inch ball valve does Indus list?
faqs.a: Worcester, A-T Controls, Mento, Warren, ITAP, Modentic, TESS and MIPEL, with models H4466YBSW R8 (Worcester) and C124 (Mento). Ratings run from 600 WOG to CWP 4,000 psi, so state the pressure you need.

faqs.q: What pressure is a 1-1/2 inch DN40 ball valve rated for?
faqs.a: The Worcester H4466YBSW R8 is marked CWP 4,000 psi, the Mento C124 PN63, the ITAP PN30 and several others 1,000 WOG or 600 WOG. PN is the rating in bar; WOG and CWP are cold working pressures before derating (see the [ball valve pressure ratings guide](/blog/ball-valve-pressure-ratings-cwp-wog)).

faqs.q: What body materials do 1-1/2 inch ball valves come in?
faqs.a: Stainless steel, WCB carbon steel, 1.4408 (CF8M) stainless and CW617N brass; seats are Lubetal and RTFE where stated. WCB is cast carbon steel and CF8M is cast 316 stainless.

faqs.q: What is the MannTek one-way Full Flow Ball Valve used for?
faqs.a: The MannTek one-way Full Flow Ball Valve is a shut-off valve for fuel handling on tank trucks, aviation refuellers, mobile fuelling units and containers. It has one inlet and one outlet, is designed for maximum flow and minimum pressure drop, and handles petrol (gasoline), diesel and jet fuel.

faqs.q: How do I read the MannTek one-way valve part numbers?
faqs.a: IH-MNT-FFBV-1W-M-050 is the one-way valve in 2 inch (DN 50) with manual actuation; DA is pneumatic double acting, SR is pneumatic spring return, and 080 and 100 are the 3 inch and 4 inch sizes. The rows show the same code for the same attribute every time.

faqs.q: What sizes does the MannTek one-way ball valve come in?
faqs.a: 2" (DN 50), 3" (DN 80) and 4" (DN 100), each with manual, pneumatic double-acting and pneumatic spring-return actuation. That gives 9 part numbers.

faqs.q: What pressure is the MannTek Full Flow Ball Valve rated for?
faqs.a: MannTek publishes 10 bar working pressure for the valve. Do not run it above that figure. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Which fuels and seals suit the MannTek one-way ball valve?
faqs.a: It is designed for petrol (gasoline), diesel and jet fuel, with aluminium body (no yellow parts) and FKM or NBR seals; low-temperature seals are available. Yellow metals such as brass and copper alloys are kept away from the fuel.

faqs.q: Does MannTek supply manuals for the Full Flow Ball Valve?
faqs.a: Yes, MannTek publishes an operating manual and a service instruction for the valve, attached in the Documents tab. Download them before the valve arrives so the site team has the procedure.

faqs.q: Which connections does the MannTek Full Flow Ball Valve take?
faqs.a: Threaded (BSP, NPT) or flanged (EN, ANSI, TW, TTMA) connections, chosen per side. It is a modular build: a valve body between bolted end flanges.

faqs.q: Can the one-way valve close if air or power fails?
faqs.a: Yes, with the pneumatic single-acting spring-return actuator: air opens the valve remotely and the spring closes it automatically, for example on loss of power. The double-acting actuator uses air to open and close.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the one-way and the two-way MannTek ball valve?
faqs.a: The one-way valve has one inlet and one outlet; the [two-way valve](/p/manntek-full-flow-ball-valve-two-way) has one inlet and two outlets, so one valve directs flow to either line, in 2" and 3" with manual or pneumatic double-acting actuation.

faqs.q: What is the MannTek two-way Full Flow Ball Valve used for?
faqs.a: The MannTek two-way Full Flow Ball Valve is a directional control valve for fuel handling on tank trucks, aviation refuellers, mobile fuelling units and containers. It has one inlet and two outlets, so one valve directs the flow to either line, and MannTek states flow in both directions is possible.

faqs.q: What does a two-way ball valve do compared with a one-way valve?
